sentences.en: The final examination, which covers all the material from chapters one through twelve, will be held next Wednesday morning.
sentences.zh: 涵蓋第一章到第十二章所有內容的期末考將在下週三早上舉行。

sentences.en: I have been studying for the past three weeks, but I still feel unprepared for the comprehensive biology exam.
sentences.zh: 我過去三週一直在讀書，但我仍然覺得對那個綜合性的生物考試準備不足。

sentences.en: The professor announced that the midterm exam would consist of both multiple-choice questions and short essay responses.
sentences.zh: 教授宣布期中考將包含選擇題和簡答論述題。

sentences.en: If you finish the test early, please review your answers carefully before submitting your paper to the invigilator.
sentences.zh: 如果你提早寫完考試，請在將試卷交給監考人員之前仔細檢查你的答案。

sentences.en: The practice exam that the teaching assistant distributed last week was significantly easier than what appeared on the actual test.
sentences.zh: 助教上週分發的模擬考比實際考試出現的內容容易很多。

sentences.en: Students who arrive more than thirty minutes late to the examination hall will not be permitted to take the test.
sentences.zh: 遲到超過三十分鐘的學生將不被允許參加考試。

sentences.en: I am extremely nervous about the oral examination tomorrow, especially since I have never done one before in this subject.
sentences.zh: 我對明天的口試極度緊張，特別是因為我從未在這個科目做過口試。

sentences.en: The exam results, which will be posted on the university portal by Friday, may take longer if there are many papers to grade.
sentences.zh: 考試成績將在週五前公布在大學網站上，如果有很多試卷要批改的話可能需要更長時間。

sentences.en: Make sure to bring your student identification card and two pencils, as the exam requires filling in a Scantron sheet.
sentences.zh: 確保帶上學生證和兩支鉛筆，因為考試需要填寫答案卡。

sentences.en: The curve that the professor applied to the exam scores raised everyone's grade by approximately seven percentage points.
sentences.zh: 教授對考試分數做的調分讓每個人的成績提高了大約七個百分點。

sentences.en: I regret not starting my review earlier, because there was simply too much material to cover in just one night of studying.
sentences.zh: 我後悔沒有早點開始複習，因為只用一晚上讀書根本無法涵蓋那麼多教材。

sentences.en: The open-book exam, contrary to what most students expected, turned out to be much more challenging than a traditional closed-book test.
sentences.zh: 開書考試與大多數學生預期的相反，結果比傳統的閉書考試更具挑戰性。

sentences.en: According to the examination regulations, any student caught cheating will receive an automatic failing grade for the entire course.
sentences.zh: 根據考試規定，任何被抓到作弊的學生將在整門課程中自動得到不及格的成績。

sentences.en: I need to schedule a makeup exam with the registrar's office because I was hospitalized on the day of the original test.
sentences.zh: 我需要跟教務處安排補考，因為我在原本考試那天住院了。

sentences.en: The time pressure during the exam made it impossible for me to complete the last two essay questions with sufficient detail.
sentences.zh: 考試期間的時間壓力使我無法用充分的細節完成最後兩道論述題。

sentences.en: Having failed the first attempt, the student decided to retake the course and dedicate more time to understanding the fundamentals.
sentences.zh: 第一次沒有通過後，這位學生決定重修這門課並花更多時間理解基礎知識。

sentences.en: The standardized test, which is administered twice a year nationwide, plays a crucial role in determining college admissions.
sentences.zh: 每年全國舉行兩次的標準化考試在決定大學入學方面扮演著至關重要的角色。

sentences.en: I would strongly advise against pulling an all-nighter before the exam, as sleep deprivation significantly impairs cognitive function.
sentences.zh: 我強烈建議不要在考試前熬夜通宵，因為睡眠不足會顯著損害認知功能。

sentences.en: The grading rubric for the essay section, which was shared with us beforehand, clearly outlines what the examiner is looking for.
sentences.zh: 事先與我們分享的論述部分評分標準清楚地列出了考官在尋找什麼。

sentences.en: Please note that electronic devices, including calculators and smartwatches, are strictly prohibited during the examination.
sentences.zh: 請注意，包括計算機和智慧手錶在內的電子設備在考試期間嚴格禁止使用。

sentences.en: The professor offered an optional extra-credit assignment for students who were dissatisfied with their performance on the midterm.
sentences.zh: 教授為對期中考表現不滿意的學生提供了一個可選的額外加分作業。

sentences.en: After reviewing the exam paper, I realized that I had misread the question and consequently provided an entirely irrelevant answer.
sentences.zh: 在檢查試卷後，我意識到我看錯了題目，因此提供了一個完全不相關的答案。

sentences.en: The cumulative final exam will test your ability to synthesize information from all the topics covered throughout the entire semester.
sentences.zh: 累積式期末考將測試你綜合整個學期涵蓋的所有主題資訊的能力。

sentences.en: I managed to finish the exam with only two minutes to spare, which did not leave me enough time to check my work.
sentences.zh: 我只剩兩分鐘的時間才寫完考試，這讓我沒有足夠的時間檢查答案。

sentences.en: The university has decided to replace traditional written exams with project-based assessments for several courses starting next year.
sentences.zh: 大學決定從明年開始在幾門課程中用專案式評量取代傳統筆試。

sentences.en: Studying in short, focused intervals with regular breaks has been proven to be more effective than marathon study sessions.
sentences.zh: 以短時間、專注的間隔搭配定期休息來學習已被證實比馬拉松式的讀書更有效。

sentences.en: The exam room was so quiet that you could hear the ticking of the clock on the wall as students concentrated on their papers.
sentences.zh: 考場安靜到可以聽到牆上時鐘的滴答聲，學生們專注在他們的試卷上。

sentences.en: Despite having studied extensively, I encountered several questions on the test that were not covered in the lectures or textbook.
sentences.zh: 儘管大量複習，我在考試中遇到了幾個講課或教科書中沒有涵蓋的問題。

sentences.en: The professor will allow students to bring one handwritten formula sheet to the calculus exam, but no printed materials are permitted.
sentences.zh: 教授將允許學生帶一張手寫的公式表到微積分考試，但不允許攜帶印刷材料。

sentences.en: I am planning to visit the tutoring center this afternoon to get help with the topics that I expect to appear on Friday's quiz.
sentences.zh: 我計畫今天下午去輔導中心，就我預期會出現在週五測驗上的主題尋求幫助。
